title: Notch Lore packet specification, version 1
description: Explicit working-file selection for a non-executing source, task, return, checkpoint or selected-file backup. The CLI additionally validates portable paths, file hashes, exclusions, bounded content and reference closure.

dirty.description: Sender declaration only; the transport does not execute Git status or certify a clean worktree.

selectedPaths.description: Project-relative regular files or directories. No glob expansion or automatic reference inclusion. Existing local edits and untracked selected files are preserved.

requiredReferences.description: Exact files that must be present in the selected payload. Conventional Markdown local links must also resolve within the payload.

task.description: Entry file, included in readingOrder. Required for task packets; null is permitted for a source snapshot without a task.

exclusions.description: Additional exact relative file/directory prefixes. Built-in credential, private/live-data, log and cache exclusions cannot be disabled. Review the actual omission ledger.

privacy.description: A recorded sender acknowledgement, not automated proof of review or of absence of private information. Content scanning has documented limits.

path.description: Portable relative POSIX path. The CLI rejects traversal, backslashes, colons, empty components, Windows device names, control characters and trailing dots/spaces; case/Unicode collisions are refused.
